title: D3.js Quick Guide
description: Find a short explanation and a worked example for each idea in the D3.js course.

entries.name: Select and append an SVG shape
entries.summary: A D3 selection points to page elements. append creates a child element, and attr sets one of its attributes.

entries.name: Put data into a join
entries.summary: A data join matches data values to elements.

entries.name: Map numbers to positions
entries.summary: A linear scale maps one number range to another.

entries.name: Give categories equal spaces
entries.summary: A band scale gives named categories separate spaces.

entries.name: Draw bars from values
entries.summary: A bar chart uses height to show a number.

entries.name: Add readable labels
entries.summary: Text labels tell readers what a chart value means.

entries.name: Draw an axis
entries.summary: An axis draws ticks and labels for a scale.

entries.name: Connect points with a line
entries.summary: A line generator turns a list of points into an SVG path.

entries.name: Make a small pie layout
entries.summary: A pie layout turns values into angles. An arc generator uses those angles to draw slice paths.

entries.name: Update an existing join
entries.summary: Calling a join again with new data updates the matching elements.

entries.name: React to a chart event
entries.summary: D3 can attach an event handler to a shape.

entries.name: Give the chart a text explanation
entries.summary: A visual chart should have a useful name and a text explanation.
